gap_details.2010-2011: Pre-window anchor loaded: Jackson bios page (jhsmiami.org/body.cfm?id=8942), 2010-12-30 capture, 18 residents by PGY heading.
gap_details.2011-2012: No roster capture. The UM page about/residents-fellows only linked to jhsmiami.org/body.cfm?id=8942, whose last Wayback capture is 2010-12 (checked body.cfm and blank.cfm print variants, jhsmiami.org prefix 2011-2014). jacksonhealth.org residency pages (2013-2019) and the 2014 Jackson PDFs (brochure, manual) carry no names. UM education/residency-program page (2012) has no roster. Common Crawl 2011-2014 on jhsmiami id=8942 and neurosurgery.med.miami.edu/about|education: nothing. Reconstructed 18 (bracketed 2010-11/2014-15 or alumni-confirmed). Unseen short-stay residents possible.
gap_details.2012-2013: Same searches as 2011-12; reconstructed 19. Jeremiah Johnson and Faiz Ahmad carried with PGY unknown (Johnson took an extra year: expected grad 2013, graduated 2014; Ahmad was PGY-2 in 2010-11 and chief in 2013-14).
gap_details.2013-2014: Same searches as 2011-12; reconstructed 20 (2014 brochure names Johnson, Ahmad, Ashour 'Chief Resident Class of 2014').
gap_details.2014-2015: Observed from the department brochure PDF 'UM_Neurosurgery_Training_Programs_2014.pdf' (captured 2015-06-16), resident page 'PGY NS-n' (NS-1 = July 2014 entrants). 20 residents, complete (3/class, 2 in the 2009 class after Ahmad's early finish).
gap_details.2020-2021: Only a 2020-07-04 capture (July), but content-dated 2020-21: new interns Brusko/Lu/S. Shah listed and all PGYs advanced. Host returned 'Site Error' from 2020-08.
gap_details.2021-2022: No capture: old host retired Aug 2020; med.miami.edu (/en/)departments/neurosurgery roster page first captured 2023-01-31 (CDX exact+prefix, gapaudit 2020-2024 on both paths and old host). Common Crawl 2020-2024 (3 SURT prefixes): no roster pages. Reconstructed 18 bracketed/alumni-confirmed; 2021 interns (Elarjani, Khalafallah, Vyas) not reconstructed as PGY-1. PHASE 2: 2021 interns Elarjani, Khalafallah, Vyas added as reconstructed PGY-1 ('Started in 07/2021' on the 2023-01 page; NPPES FL trainee NPIs April 2021).
gap_details.2022-2023: Observed (2023-01-31, /en/ path). PGY-7 Daniel Eichberg omitted by the page; PHASE 2 added him in a separate manual capture (bracketed by PGY-5 2020-21 and alumni grad 2023). news.med.miami.edu 'Neurosurgeons Showcase at Spine Summit 2023' (April 18, 2023): 'many of our 21 residents' = 20 listed + Eichberg, so the year is complete.
gap_details.2023-2024: Still no roster capture (Wayback exact+prefix on med.miami.edu/(en/)departments/neurosurgery 2023-02..2024-07; graduate.jacksonhealth.org has no roster; news.med.miami.edu 2023-24 articles give no resident list; Common Crawl 2023-2024 incl. retried CC-MAIN-2024-26: nothing). PHASE 2 reconstruction adds: PGY-7 Joshua Burks, Aria Jamshidi, Christian Theodotou (page 'Graduate in 06/2024'; Jamshidi is a UW Neurological Surgery fellow 2024-25; Theodotou NPPES neurosurgery practice in Orlando certified 2024-07-01; Burks UM affiliations to 2025 + NPPES FL/CA neurosurgery licences) and PGY-1 Govindarajan, Tigchelaar ('Started in 07/2023'; FL trainee NPIs 2023-03-30 / 2023-04-03). Katherine Berry (PGY-6) not added (never seen later) but UM Neurological Surgery affiliations on papers through 2024-04 indicate she was still present in 2023-24. 2023 class: O'Hehir 'Started in 07/2024' as PGY-2, graduates 2030 with the 2023 class; her FL trainee NPI was issued 2023-04-05, the same week as the two 2023 interns, so she was probably in a Florida PGY-1 in 2023-24 earmarked for this class. A third original 2023 intern leaving cannot be excluded without the roster (lead: Andres M. Corona, UM student with neurosurgery papers 2021-23, FL trainee NPI 2023-03-20, UM Dept of Surgery affiliations 2025-26 -- no evidence he was ever a neurosurgery resident).
gap_details.2024-2025: Two captures (2024-08-24, 2024-12-27) identical; Katherine Berry (2018 class) absent, classmates Boddu/Kader PGY-7.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page fetched 2026-09-27; PGYs advanced, 4 new PGY-1s; loaded.

departures.name: Katherine Berry
departures.note: 2018 entrant (earlier IU PGY-1 2017-18). Last roster PGY-5 2022-23; UM affiliations on papers through 2024-04; absent 2024-25 (classmates Boddu/Kader PGY-7) and later; not on alumni list. Left before PGY-7 ~mid-2024, outcome unknown (NPPES name match: Neurological Surgery, Pittsburgh PA, updated 2024-06-13; not on UPMC/AHN resident or fellow pages). training_history: completed=no, departure_type=unknown, end_year 2024.

joiners.name: Mary Margaret O'Hehir
joiners.note: Page: 'Started in 07/2024', graduates 06/2030 with the 2023 class. UB MD; FL trainee NPI 2023-04-05 (same week as Miami's 2023 interns) -> PGY-1 2023-24 probably in Florida (prelim or equivalent), not on the Buffalo NS roster. Recorded in training_history as joined at PGY-2 in 2024.

other_notes: Faiz Ahmad: PGY-2 in 2010-11 (2009 class) but Chief Resident Class of 2014; alumni page lists him under both 2014 and 2016. Accelerated completion, not a departure.
Jeremiah Johnson: PGY-5 2010-11 expected grad 2013, graduated 2014 (extra year).
Daniel Eichberg: missing from the 2022-23 page's chief list, but alumni page grad 2023 -> completed.

Lead check: Javier Figueroa never appears on any Miami resident roster (2010-11 Jackson page, 2014-15/2015-16 brochures, 2015-2020 current-residents captures, 2023-2026 pages). He is listed on neurosurgery.med.miami.edu/education/current-fellows as a Trauma fellow (Jackson South): 'Started 07/2017, Graduate 06/2018' (2017-09 to 2018-05 captures), 'Started 07/2018, Graduate 06/2019' (2018-08, 2019-01), 'Trauma Fellow, Started 07/2019, Graduates 06/2020' (2019-09, 2020-02). So his 2017-2020 Miami/Jackson time was a neurotrauma fellowship, not a neurosurgery residency; his absence from the resident alumni list is expected.
